Tia had been the top student in her class ever since high school began, but the harsh reality was that her abusive stepfather forced her into it through beatings. A few weeks ago, she finally stood up to him, and he kicked her out of the house. Since then, she’s been staying at different houses each night.

Tia had to stop attending her classes because she had nowhere to live, often resorting to sleeping on the streets. Her classmates, who once admired her, began to bully her when they saw her in such a vulnerable state. The bullying escalated, and they even beat her up, leaving her devastated and shocked that those she once considered friends could be so cruel. One night, after being attacked, Tia was forced to run away from her sleeping spot, losing all her belongings her clothes, phone, and other essentials. Desperate and cold, she snuck into a nearby apartment building and made her way to the 9th floor, intending to end it all by jumping off the top floor. As she climbed onto the stairway wall, she smiled before jumping. But just before she blacked out, she caught a glimpse of someone catching her.

When Tia woke up, she found herself in a warm, comfortable bed. As she looked around the unfamiliar room, she quickly got up to leave. Upon opening the door, she saw her old upper classmate who had helped her pass all her exams passed out on the couch. She woke him up, and they started talking. Tia shared her struggles, and he offered to let her stay with him for a few weeks. Tia was surprised by his kindness; not only had he helped her academically, but now he was offering her a place to stay rent-free. She quickly became attached to him, cooking for him, doing his laundry, and cleaning his apartment. However, Tia found herself hating him at times, especially when he would bring other girls over. Their fights would escalate, with Tia threatening to take her own life if he didn’t send the girl away. Despite knowing he didn’t see her as a romantic interest or partner, Tia didn’t care. She admired him, looked up to him, and was deeply grateful that he had saved her life.
